# pve_notification_endpoint_goty (Resource)

Manages a Gotify notification endpoint (`POST/PUT/DELETE /cluster/notifications/endpoints/gotify/{name}`). Every mutation is synchronous per the pin (no task is spawned).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_notification_endpoint_goty" "mobile_push" {
  name    = "gotify"
  server  = "https://gotify.example.com"
  token   = "your-gotify-application-token"
  comment = "Mobile push notifications"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the endpoint (PVE `pve-configid` format). Changing this value forces recreation.
- `server` (String) Server URL of the Gotify instance.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Secret token for the Gotify application. Write-only: PVE never returns it, so drift cannot be detected.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Comment. Removed when unset on update.
- `disable` (Boolean) Disable this target. PVE defaults to `false`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing gotify endpoint by its name:
terraform import pve_notification_endpoint_goty.mobile_push gotify
```
